description: HENRICO, Va. — Today, WAVY’s Truth Tracker rated Rep. Rob Wittman’s attack ad on Shannon Taylor’s handling of the Henrico NICU child abuse case as FALSE. This is the second time this week that Wittman’s ad was rated FALSE, following an earlier 12 On Your Side fact-check.
